--- title: "RTC Fact Sheet: 2025 State of Evictions" format: html: code-fold: true --- ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} library(DBI) library(RPostgres) library(flextable) library(sf) library(tidyverse) library(socratadata) library(lubridate) library(writexl) # Ensure that the Quarto render and RStudio read the same environment vars readRenviron(".Renviron") con <- dbConnect( RPostgres::Postgres(), dbname = Sys.getenv("PG_DBNAME"), host = Sys.getenv("PG_HOST"), port = Sys.getenv("PG_PORT"), user = Sys.getenv("PG_USER"), password = Sys.getenv("PG_PASSWORD") ) ``` ::: The following analyses were performed in support of [Right to Counsel's](https://www.righttocounselnyc.org/) annual State of Evictions fact sheet. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # First, pull data. Then, work locally in R. ### Evictions db SQL queries ### # Eviction Filings, 2020 - 2025, all filings_20_25 <- dbGetQuery(con, " SELECT DISTINCT(i.indexnumberid), fileddate, court FROM oca_index i WHERE i.fileddate >= MAKE_DATE(2020,1,1) AND i.fileddate <= MAKE_DATE(2025,12,31) AND i.classification IN ('Holdover', 'Non-Payment') AND (i.propertytype = 'Residential' OR i.propertytype IS NULL); ") # Eviction Filings, 2020 - 2025, with location filings_20_25_sf <- st_read(con, query = " SELECT DISTINCT(i.indexnumberid), fileddate, court, ST_Transform(a.geom, 2263) AS geom FROM oca_index i JOIN oca_addresses a ON i.indexnumberid = a.indexnumberid WHERE i.fileddate >= MAKE_DATE(2020,1,1) AND i.fileddate <= MAKE_DATE(2025,12,31) AND i.classification IN ('Holdover', 'Non-Payment') AND (i.propertytype = 'Residential' OR i.propertytype IS NULL) AND a.geom IS NOT NULL; ") # Executed Evictions, 2020 - 2025, all executions_20_25 <- dbGetQuery(con, " SELECT DISTINCT(i.indexnumberid), w.executiondate, i.court FROM oca_index i JOIN oca_warrants w ON i.indexnumberid = w.indexnumberid WHERE w.executiondate >= MAKE_DATE(2020,1,1) AND w.executiondate <= MAKE_DATE(2025,12,31) AND i.classification IN ('Holdover', 'Non-Payment') AND (i.propertytype = 'Residential' OR i.propertytype IS NULL) AND w.executiondate IS NOT NULL; ") # Executed Evictions, 2020 - 2025, with location executions_20_25_sf <- st_read(con, query = " WITH executed_evictions AS ( SELECT DISTINCT(i.indexnumberid), w.executiondate, i.court FROM oca_index i JOIN oca_warrants w ON i.indexnumberid = w.indexnumberid WHERE w.executiondate >= MAKE_DATE(2020,1,1) AND w.executiondate <= MAKE_DATE(2025,12,31) AND i.classification IN ('Holdover', 'Non-Payment') AND (i.propertytype = 'Residential' OR i.propertytype IS NULL) AND w.executiondate IS NOT NULL ) SELECT e.*, ST_TRANSFORM(a.geom, 2263) FROM executed_evictions e JOIN oca_addresses a on e.indexnumberid = a.indexnumberid WHERE a.geom IS NOT NULL ") ### Boundary Files ### # NYC Boundary via borough boundary union nyc <- read_sf("https://services5.arcgis.com/GfwWNkhOj9bNBqoJ/arcgis/rest/services/NYC_Borough_Boundary/FeatureServer/0/query?where=1=1&outFields=*&outSR=4326&f=pgeojson") |> st_transform(2263) |> st_make_valid() |> st_union() # NYS Assembly nysad <- read_sf("https://services6.arcgis.com/EbVsqZ18sv1kVJ3k/ArcGIS/rest/services/NYS_Assembly_Districts/FeatureServer/0/query?where=0%3D0&outFields=*&f=geojson") |> st_transform(2263) |> st_make_valid() # NYS Senate nyss <- read_sf("https://services6.arcgis.com/EbVsqZ18sv1kVJ3k/ArcGIS/rest/services/NYS_Senate_Districts/FeatureServer/0/query?where=0%3D0&outFields=*&f=geojson") |> st_transform(2263) |> st_make_valid() # NYC Council nyc_council <- read_sf("https://services5.arcgis.com/GfwWNkhOj9bNBqoJ/arcgis/rest/services/NYC_City_Council_Districts/FeatureServer/0/query?where=1=1&outFields=*&outSR=4326&f=pgeojson") |> st_transform(2263) |> st_make_valid() # NYC Council members nyc_council_members <- soc_read( "https://data.cityofnewyork.us/City-Government/City-Council-Members-1999-to-Present-/uvw5-9znb.json" ) |> # Filter to current term filter(Sys.Date() %within% interval(start = term_start, end = term_end)) # Join CMs to spatial file nyc_council <- nyc_council |> left_join(nyc_council_members |> select(name, district), by = join_by(CounDist == district)) |> # Designate Vacant seats mutate(name = replace_na(name, "Vacant")) # NYC Boundaries via Borough union bb <- read_sf("https://services5.arcgis.com/GfwWNkhOj9bNBqoJ/arcgis/rest/services/NYC_Borough_Boundary/FeatureServer/0/query?where=1=1&outFields=*&outSR=4326&f=pgeojson") |> st_transform(2263) |> st_make_valid() |> st_union() # NYS Counties nys_counties <- read_sf("https://services6.arcgis.com/EbVsqZ18sv1kVJ3k/ArcGIS/rest/services/NYS_Civil_Boundaries/FeatureServer/2/query?where=0%3D0&outFields=*&f=geojson") |> st_transform(2263) # Separate out upstate / downstate nysad_downstate <- st_filter(nysad, bb, .predicate = st_intersects) nysad_upstate <- st_filter(nysad, bb, .predicate = st_disjoint) nyss_downstate <- st_filter(nyss, bb, .predicate = st_intersects) nyss_upstate <- st_filter(nyss, bb, .predicate = st_disjoint) ``` ::: ## Cumulative Eviction Filings ### Number of eviction filings from January 1, 2020 - December 31, 2025 In New York State, there were **849,786** eviction-oriented (holdover and non-payment) filings from January 1, 2020 to December 31, 2025. Please note that this analysis **excludes commercial evictions within New York City.** Unfortunately, outside of NYC, excluding commercial from residential eviction filings and executions is not possible given the current data. ## Annual eviction filings ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} eviction_count_annual_df <- filings_20_25 |> group_by(filed_year = year(fileddate)) |> summarize(count = n()) ``` ::: The number of eviction-related (holdover and non-payment) eviction filings per year is: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} eviction_count_annual_table <- eviction_count_annual_df |> flextable() |> set_table_properties(width = 1, layout = "autofit") |> set_header_labels( filed_year = "Year", count = "Eviction Filings" ) |> colformat_num(j=1, big.mark = "") |> align(j=1, align = "left", part = "all") eviction_count_annual_table ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}

executions, winter filings, winter executions for all political districts filings_20_25_sf <- filings_20_25_sf |> mutate(winter_season = case_when(month(fileddate) >= 11 ~ TRUE, month(fileddate) < 4 ~ TRUE, month(fileddate) == 4 & day(fileddate) <= 15 ~ TRUE, .default = FALSE )) executions_20_25_sf <- executions_20_25_sf |> mutate(winter_season = case_when(month(executiondate) >= 11 ~ TRUE, month(executiondate) < 4 ~ TRUE, month(executiondate) == 4 & day(executiondate) <= 15 ~ TRUE, .default = FALSE )) ### Assembly Districts ### nysad_compiled <- nysad |> select(District, Name, Party) |> mutate(Region = case_when(District %in% nysad_upstate$District ~ "Upstate", District %in% nysad_downstate$District ~ "Downstate", .default = NA)) executions_20_25_nysad <- executions_20_25_sf |> st_join(nysad_compiled |> select(District)) nysad_compiled <- nysad_compiled |> left_join( bind_rows( nysad_downstate_5year, nysad_upstate_5year ) |> rename("filings_20_25" = "Eviction Filings") |> select(!Name), by = join_by(District) ) |> left_join( bind_rows( nysad_downstate_1year, nysad_upstate_1year ) |> rename("filings_25" = "Eviction Filings") |> select(!Name), by = join_by(District) ) |> left_join(executions_20_25_nysad |> st_drop_geometry() |> group_by(District) |> summarize(executions_20_25 = n())) |> left_join(executions_20_25_nysad |> filter(year(executiondate) == 2025) |>
